segments.he: וְאִם הָיְתָה מְנִיקָה. דָּרֵשׁ רַבִּי עוּלָּא רַבָּה אַפִּיתְחָא דְּבֵי נְשִׂיאָה: אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ אֵין אָדָם זָן אֶת בָּנָיו וּבְנוֹתָיו כְּשֶׁהֵן קְטַנִּים, אֲבָל זָן קְטַנֵּי קְטַנִּים.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And if she is nursing,» the required amount is reduced from her earnings and is added to the sum she receives for her sustenance. «Rabbi Ulla the Great taught at the entrance to the house of the Nasi: Although» the Sages «said» that «a person is not» obligated «to sustain his sons and daughters when they are young, still, he» must «sustain the very young ones.»
